summary.intent: Coordinate four parallel agent tracks on the monokl project (match-path speed, printed-bytes budget, concept-query eval, member-block design), get their PRs reviewed, then address Entire finding #35 on the stacked snippets PR.
summary.outcome: Three PRs (#61, #62, #63) were opened and marked ready, with #61 and #62 later merged into the snippets branch. The speed investigation found the cause but made no fix. The finding #35 was reproduced as a gate exiting 1 when there was nothing to score; it was fixed in scripts/rg-compare.py and committed, but the push and resolving the finding were still pending.

repo: The ~50 ms match-path latency is the first call to tiktoken_rs::o200k_base_singleton() in budget::count_tokens, which builds the BPE vocabulary (~55 ms); no-match searches skip it and stay near 6 ms. Pipeline stages (search, parse, rank) total ~3 ms.

--max-tokens and --max-bytes now count the rendered row line (output::agent::search_row_text), not block code. apply_budget takes a row_text fn so core stays cap-free. Defaults stay 50 / 20,000 / 2 MiB; the 50-row cap usually binds (worst observed output 11 KB).

scripts/rg-compare.py scores identifier lookups (gate 90%, 56/59) and multi-word questions from scripts/rg-compare.questions (gate 75% via --min-question-recall, 14/18). Answers are re-verified by rg against the pinned zustand/zod/axios sha each run, so stale rows fail loudly.
tests/cli.rs needs a cfg(feature="cli") gate because it now uses monokl::budget.
Project checks: just lint, just test (nextest + doctests), doc-check, check-drift, machete, changesets, coverage.

code.finding: count_tokens calls tiktoken_rs::o200k_base_singleton(); the first call costs ~55 ms and is the dominant match-path cost.
Question and identifier gates failed with exit 1 when there was nothing to score (e.g. a narrowed run); fixed so a gate with nothing to score is skipped and says so.

friction: The perf agent could not fix the issue because the cause was in budget.rs, owned by another track.
`sample` could not profile the binary because each run exits too quickly to attach.
Entire did not open a PR for the snippets trail because its base branch had already merged; it needed a manual relink.
Finding #35 required several commands to map the change number to a trail and branch.
The budget agent wrote the new CLI tests after the code, so they were never seen failing first.
open_items: Push the rg-compare gate fix and resolve finding #35 in Entire.
Decide whether to replace tiktoken with a bytes/4 estimate (removes ~55 ms, dependency, and vocabulary data); planned as a separate branch after #62 merges since both touch budget.rs.
Merge the agents' decision-log text into the spec log after #63 merges.
Implement member-level blocks per the design memo (PR 1: class methods; then object-literal/class-property functions; then hooks), after verifying the OXC node names against the version in use.
Diagnose the four question-eval misses (zod 'json schema convert' and 'safe parse result', axios 'build full path base url' and 'dispatch request adapter').
The 'only top-level declarations are searched' hint still prints when a budget cut leaves zero rows.
Field docs for SearchResponse.total_bytes and total_tokens in types.rs are not updated; the whole-document cap (header, hints) is not counted.
2 MiB byte default is far above observed output; lowering it needs readme_defaults.rs to parse KiB.
PR checks (macOS Test, Coverage, Entire Gates) were still pending on #63.
